content:
Context: 3. Stepping up

a Senior Secretariat Assistant (SSA) on promotion to the post of Assistant Section Officer (ASO) gets his pay fixed under FR 22 (I) (a) (1) with reference to the pay drawn in the post of SSA, whereas the pay of ASO (DR) is fixed under Rule 8 of CCS (RP) Rules, 2016 at the minimum pay or the first Cell in the Level, applicable to ASO to which he is appointed. In such a case, the senior ASO (DR) cannot claim pay parity with that of the promotee junior ASO.
